name: WorkflowTemplate
description: Represents one of the workflows available for the current document.
remarks: A WorkflowTemplate object corresponds to one of the options displayed in the Start New Workflow dialog box. On a webpage, the workflow templates are displayed as a list of options.
example:
Sub DisplayWorkTemplates()
Dim objWorkflowTemplates As WorkflowTemplates
Dim objWorkflowTemplate As WorkflowTemplate
Dim cnt As Integer

Set objWorkflowTemplates = Document.GetWorkflowTemplates()

For cnt = 1 To objWorkflowTemplates.Count
 Debug.Print objWorkflowTemplate(cnt).Name
Next

Set objWorkflowTemplate = objWorkflowTemplates(1)
objWorkflowTemplate.Show

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WorkflowTemplate object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WorkflowTemplate object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of a template used to create a workflow instance. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the WorkflowTemplate object. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gets the description of a workflow template. Read-only.

properties.name: DocumentLibraryName
properties.description: Gets the name of the document library associated with the workflow template. Read-only.

properties.name: DocumentLibraryURL
properties.description: Gets the URL address of the document library where workflow templates are stored. Read-only.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Displays a workflow-specific configuration user interface for the specified WorkflowTemplate object.
